schools.next_step: Send midyear report after first semester

card_lines.label: MSRP
card_lines.text: Sticker is about $89,500 per year before any aid, with a full cost of attendance near $94,000 once you add housing, food, books, and travel home twice a year.

card_lines.label: Deadline
card_lines.text: Early decision materials are locked; the midyear report and first-semester grades still need to reach the portal by mid-January or the file may be marked incomplete.

card_lines.label: Scholarship
card_lines.text: There is no automatic merit grid for this school — need-based aid only — so every dollar depends on CSS Profile, verification, and how the institutional form is filled out.

card_lines.label: Aid forms
card_lines.text: CSS Profile and the noncustodial parent form are still open; the institutional aid questionnaire has a soft deadline two weeks after the application is marked complete.

card_lines.label: Thackston
card_lines.text: Counselor notes say the essays and recommendations are among the strongest on this list, and the interview (if offered) should emphasize the studio work from junior year.

card_lines.label: Marist data
card_lines.text: Historical ED admit rate for this major sits near 12 percent; yield among admits is high, so a deferral or denial should not be read as a signal about the rest of the list.

card_lines.label: Why
card_lines.text: Design studio from the first year, a structured co-op network with local firms, and faculty who actually place students into paid summer roles that count for credit.

card_lines.label: Why not
card_lines.text: Intro sequences are large, the campus is a long flight from home, and winters are hard if the student wants an urban weekend culture every month.

card_lines.label: Confirm
card_lines.text: Portal shows all supplements received and the interview was waived; double-check that the midyear report request was sent to the school counseling office.

card_lines.label: Likelihood
card_lines.text: Counselor likelihood note: still a reach even with ED, but the academic match is real and the portfolio pieces already on file are stronger than last year's admits.

detail.counselor_take: Strong fit; plan the rest of the list anyway.
